metadata.question: Did the glacial ice and snow cover on Mount Stanley in the Rwenzori Mountains decrease between 2020 and 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 for 10 m snow/ice detection (bands B3/B2 and NDSI). The 2022–2024 period is Siberia-like cloudy in equatorial Africa, so widen the dry-season window (annual composites). 2. Masking: SCL cloud/snow and QA60 clouds; keep land pixels; create annual median ND-SI (NDSI or Normalised Snow Index ≈ (B3-B8)/(B3+B8)) for both years to minimise clouds. 3. Validation: Count pixels > 0.3 ND-SI within a 350 m buffer around the central Rwenzori top; check collection size → C1, post-mask pixel count → C2, invalid result → C3; compare the 2020 vs 2024 sum inside the buffer and decide A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Mt Stanley summit point (approx. 0.385° N, 29.87° E) pt = ee.Geometry.Point([29.87, 0.385]) roi = pt.buffer(400) # ~350 m radius buffer scale = 30 # Sentinel-2 native def get_annual(col_id, year): col = (ee.ImageCollection(col_id) .filterBounds(pt) .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None # Cloud/snow QAs: keep clear land (SCL 4) and snow/ice (SCL 11) pixels def clear(img): s2 = img.clip(roi).select(['B3','B8','SCL']).rename(['B3','B8','SCL']) clear = s2.select('SCL').eq(4).Or(s2.select('SCL').eq(11)) ndsi = s2.select('B3').subtract(s2.select('B8')).divide(s2.select('B3').add(s2.select('B8'))) return ndsi.updateMask(clear) return col.map(clear).median() def snow_sum(img): snow = img.gt(0.30) return snow.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi') s20 = get_annual('COPERNICUS/S2',2020) s24 = get_annual('COPERNICUS/S2',2024) if s20 is None or s24 is None: print("No images 2020 and/or 2024.") print("C1") else: a20 = ee.Number(s20.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi')) a24 = ee.Number(s24.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi')) c20 = s20.gt(0.30).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), roi, scale).get('ndsi').getInfo() c24 = s24.gt(0.30).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), roi, scale).get('ndsi').getInfo() if c20==0 and c24==0: print("No snow pixels.") print("C2") else: sum_m2_20 = a20.getInfo() sum_m2_24 = a24.getInfo() print(f"2020: {sum_m2_20:.0f} m² | 2024: {sum_m2_24:.0f} m²") if sum_m2_24 is None or sum_m2_20 is None: print("C3") else: decreased = sum_m2_24 < sum_m2_20 print("A" if decreased else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Mt Stanley summit point (approx. 0.385° N, 29.87° E)
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([29.87, 0.385])
roi = pt.buffer(400)          # ~350 m radius buffer
scale = 30                    # Sentinel-2 native

def get_annual(col_id, year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection(col_id)
           .filterBounds(pt)
           .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
           .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    # Cloud/snow QAs: keep clear land (SCL 4) and snow/ice (SCL 11) pixels
    def clear(img):
        s2 = img.clip(roi).select(['B3','B8','SCL']).rename(['B3','B8','SCL'])
        clear = s2.select('SCL').eq(4).Or(s2.select('SCL').eq(11))
        ndsi = s2.select('B3').subtract(s2.select('B8')).divide(s2.select('B3').add(s2.select('B8')))
        return ndsi.updateMask(clear)
    return col.map(clear).median()

def snow_sum(img):
    snow = img.gt(0.30)
    return snow.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=roi, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi')

s20 = get_annual('COPERNICUS/S2',2020)
s24 = get_annual('COPERNICUS/S2',2024)
if s20 is None or s24 is None:
    print("No images 2020 and/or 2024.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    a20 = ee.Number(s20.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi'))
    a24 = ee.Number(s24.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('ndsi'))
    c20 = s20.gt(0.30).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), roi, scale).get('ndsi').getInfo()
    c24 = s24.gt(0.30).reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), roi, scale).get('ndsi').getInfo()
    if c20==0 and c24==0:
        print("No snow pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        sum_m2_20 = a20.getInfo()
        sum_m2_24 = a24.getInfo()
        print(f"2020: {sum_m2_20:.0f} m² | 2024: {sum_m2_24:.0f} m²")
        if sum_m2_24 is None or sum_m2_20 is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            decreased = sum_m2_24 < sum_m2_20
            print("<answer>A</answer>" if decreased else "<answer>B</answer>")
